scope: Targeted Android build, runtime, update, input, lifecycle and resource checks on specified emulators, plus automated regression checks. Not a guarantee for every device.

automated_checks.expected_corrupt_save_fixture_parse_erro: Expected ConfigFile errors from deliberately damaged fixtures; no unexpected script or engine errors.

initial_functional_run: credits Back and first reused pointer
Home return remains paused until explicit resume
android_runtime.runtime_basis: Functional run used identical game payloads before a local preparation report was removed; final APK installed, launched and passed targeted input, pause and retained-settings checks.
final_apk_smoke_checks: original-signature update install and startup succeeded
Back pause freezes timer at 4.399 seconds across two seconds

android_runtime.update_fixture: Explicit synthetic progress fixture, then an upgrade changed and saved by the original app; not real completed races.
functional_checks: actual accelerator touch and simultaneous throttle/steering
graphics preferences survive cold start and final update
credits Back and first touch reuse
background while garage or credits open keeps pause
final_apk_smoke_checks: all 16 progress fields and high/60 preference preserved

known_limits: No physical ARM64 or ARM32 phone has been tested. Device FPS, heat, memory pressure and touch feel remain unverified.

Legacy SwiftShader 4.0.0.1 software graphics failed shader linking. A direct reproduction confirmed its UBO/register limitation. Use emulator hardware graphics; lowering the game quality does not repair this software-driver issue.
Each hardware-accelerated emulator recorded a stale shader-cache rebuild warning during update. No script error, crash or ANR was observed in the final specified runtime runs.
30/60 FPS controls specify a target, not a promise that every phone sustains that rate.
ARM32/x86 native libraries target legacy 4 KB page devices; 16 KB alignment is verified for 64-bit ABIs only.
asset_substitution: Public build uses original AEROGRID GT geometry, with the original internal vehicle ID, game performance and save compatibility. The original reference model is not publicly distributed.
